brief.scope:
Review the watchdog backlog fix and the watch skill, slice one (PR #244, lane/session-20260916-f, head 515e5b72). Contract: ops/conductor/watchdog-lever.md.
Aim skepticism at: the ruling that a watcher reports nothing about what it can see at start (closed records, no-copy directories, unreadable inputs) unless --report-existing is given, and only what changes after start speaks; the claim that no live condition changed, pinned by a test that plants a directory after start; the contract wording that replaced the old carve-out; the class-level fixture override adding --report-existing to planted-closed families; and whether .claude/skills/watch/SKILL.md tells a session anything the tools and contracts do not measure.

findings.where: ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py:918 silent(); ops/conductor/watchdog-lever.md §The lines and §Proposed efficiency update
findings.claim: Declared (watchdog-lever.md §The lines): "Only what changes after start speaks: a record that closes, a directory that appears, inputs that become unreadable while the process runs are live and are reported without the flag." Declared (same file, efficiency bullet): "an amended fingerprint is scanned again and can report a newly introduced deviation." Practiced: silent() is `return record_id in self.startup_silent`, a set of directory names frozen in Watch.__init__ from kinds closed/no-copy/error. A name in that set never reports deviations, drift, no-copy, or InputUnavailable, even after its kind or fingerprint changes. The cited live pin (ClosedAtStartIsSilent.test_an_unreadable_directory_that_appears_after_start_is_said) plants a new job directory whose record.json is a symlink — a new name, not inputs of an existing job becoming unreadable; TickError's record.json-as-directory plant is only covered as backlog with --report-existing. Measured: a no-copy dir present at start that later gains a closed tripped record prints `closed … env=tripped` (not in startup_closed) and no deviation line (in startup_silent); replacing a closed-at-start record.json with a symlink prints nothing; amending a closed-at-start envelope note with "Assumption:" prints nothing.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, threading
from pathlib import Path
SNAP=Path('.').resolve(); TOOL=SNAP/'ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py'; CONF=SNAP/'ops/lane.conf'
def rec(rid, status='closed', env='tripped'):
    return {'id':rid,'job':'implement','status':status,'harness':{'name':'grok'},'caps':{'timeout':600},
            'at':{'launched':'2026-09-16T08:00:00Z','closed':'2026-09-16T08:05:00Z' if status=='closed' else None},
            'result':{'envelope':{'status':env,'findings':[{'severity':'p2','where':'x','claim':'c','reproduce':'r'}],'note':''},'changed_paths':['ops/a.py']}}
def watch(store, mutate, seconds=0.8):
    env=os.environ.copy(); env['LANE_CONF']=str(CONF); env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED']='1'; env.pop('DISPATCH_JOBS', None)
    argv=[sys.executable,'-u',str(TOOL),'--store',str(store),'--no-forge','--tick','0.15']
    t=threading.Thread(target=lambda:(time.sleep(0.25), mutate())); t.start()
    p=subprocess.run(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=2',str(seconds),*argv], cwd=str(SNAP), env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=seconds+4)
    t.join(2); return p.stdout
store=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'dispatch'; rid='20260916T080000Z-code-grok-nocopy1'; job=store/rid; job.mkdir(parents=True); (job/'note.txt').write_text('x\n')
payload=rec(rid); out=watch(store, lambda:(job/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload)+'\n'))
assert 'closed ' in out and 'deviation ' not in out, out  # closed line speaks; deviation stays muted
store=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'dispatch'; rid='20260916T080000Z-code-grok-closed1'; job=store/rid; job.mkdir(parents=True)
(job/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(rec(rid))+'\n')
def unread():
    (job/'record.real.json').write_text('{}\n'); p=job/'record.json'; p.unlink(); p.symlink_to(job/'record.real.json')
out=watch(store, unread); assert 'deviation unavailable' not in out and 'InputUnavailable' not in out, out
print('ok')
PY

findings.where: .claude/skills/watch/SKILL.md flag table, backlog paragraph, and pre-fix awk recipe
findings.claim: The watch skill tells a session things this change's tool and contract do not measure, and one recipe is false. Declared in the skill flag table: "`--report-existing` | report the backlog: everything already closed at start"; backlog paragraph: "every family — closed, deviation, no record copy, drift". Practiced in the same slice's contract (watchdog-lever.md §The lines, 515e5b72): backlog is "a record already closed, a job directory with no record copy, and a job directory whose inputs cannot be read" and the silent set includes error-kind unreadable inputs. The Monitor example is described as "stalls, deviations, CI" but the command is `--no-forge` with a grep that has no `ci ` pattern. Declared of the pre-fix awk: "A line naming no record — stall, ci, heartbeat, the error line — passes." Practiced: `stall lane/foo: no dispatch running, 50 min since 20260915T120000Z-code-grok-old` matches `[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z` and is dropped when today is 20260916. "Two of these in a row is a defect row" and "timeout_ms (30 minutes is the ceiling)" are not in watchdog-lever.md, monitor-lever.md, or any test of this change.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
skill=Path('.claude/skills/watch/SKILL.md').read_text(); contract=Path('ops/conductor/watchdog-lever.md').read_text()
assert 'everything already closed at start' in skill
assert 'unreadable' not in skill.split('Backlog is silent')[1].split('##')[0]
assert 'a job directory whose inputs cannot be read' in contract
import subprocess, datetime
today=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%d')
yest=(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)-datetime.timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
stall=f'stall lane/foo: no dispatch running, 50 min since {yest}T120000Z-code-grok-old\n'
awk=r'''awk -v today="%s" '$0 !~ /[0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}Z/ || $0 ~ today {print}' '''%today
out=subprocess.check_output(['bash','-lc',awk], input=stall, text=True)
assert stall.strip() not in out, repr(out)  # skill claims stall passes; the id-bearing form is dropped
print('ok')
PY

findings.where: ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py:1282 armed line; :1302 --report-existing help; ops/conductor/watchdog-lever.md `watchdog armed` bullet
findings.claim: After backlog grew to no-copy and unreadable, the first line a session reads still reports only closed records: practiced help is "report records already closed at start" and armed is "<n> closed records ignored" (n = len(startup_closed), kinds closed only). A store whose only backlog is a no-copy directory prints "0 closed records ignored" while silent() still mutes later deviations on that name (same measurement as the no-copy-then-record case). LD-68.md repair still says the startup set covers "closed and no-copy" and does not name error-kind.
